evidence_items.explanation: The report documents contemporary concerns consistent with diminishing returns. The private results lack resource-normalized measurements and sufficiently precise event dates for the target period.

unresolved_gaps: No comparable frontier-generation series establishes declining capability gains per proportional increase in pretraining resources.
The available reports do not separate scaling effects from other training changes.
A conclusion about prediction loss would not automatically establish the claimed practical capability slowdown.
